data.name: Description
data.value: Manage the Windows or macOS tray companion (Experimental)

data.name: StartDescription
data.value: Start or restore the tray icon (Experimental)

data.name: StopDescription
data.value: Stop the tray without stopping AppHosts (Experimental)

data.name: Started
data.value: The experimental Aspire tray is ready.

data.name: Stopped
data.value: The Aspire tray is stopped. AppHosts were not stopped.

data.name: UnsupportedPlatform
data.value: The experimental Aspire tray supports Windows and macOS x64/ARM64 installations. Linux is not supported.

data.name: NativeCliRequired
data.value: Starting the experimental tray requires an installed native Aspire CLI executable. Managed development builds and 'dotnet aspire.dll' are not supported.

data.name: BundleRequired
data.value: The experimental Aspire tray requires a leased, versioned CLI bundle. No usable bundle was found. Install a Windows or macOS Aspire bundle that includes the tray companion.

data.name: PayloadMissing
data.value: The CLI bundle does not contain the tray companion for this platform (Windows: tray/aspire-tray.exe and tray/Aspire.ico; macOS: tray/Aspire Tray.app). Install a matching native Aspire bundle, or run 'aspire setup --force' to repair an incomplete extraction.

data.name: HelperFailed
data.value: The Aspire tray '{0}' helper failed with exit code {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the start or stop subcommand name. {1} is the helper exit code.

data.name: HelperTimedOut
data.value: The Aspire tray '{0}' helper did not acknowledge completion within 30 seconds.
data.comment: {0} is the start or stop subcommand name.

data.name: OperationFailed
data.comment: {0} is the start or stop subcommand name. {1} is the underlying error message.
